original: It shall be a constant endeavour of every public authority to take steps in accordance with the requirements of clause (b) of sub-section (1) to provide as much information suomotu to the public at regular intervals through various means of communications, including internet, so that the public have minimum resort to the use of this Act to obtain information.
simplification: Government offices should share lots of information online and in other ways by themselves, so people don't have to ask for it.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: regular intervals / clause (b) dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the regular-intervals requirement and the cross-reference to clause (b) of sub-section (1); 'government offices' replaces public authority.

original: If the State Chief Information Commissioner or a State Information Commissioner in any way, concerned or interested in any contract or agreement made by or on behalf of the Government of the State or participates in any way in the profit thereof or in any benefit or emoluments arising therefrom otherwise than as a member and in common with the other members of an incorporated company, he shall, for the purposes of sub-section (1), be deemed to be guilty of misbehaviour.
simplification: If a state information commissioner makes money from a deal with the state government, that counts as bad behaviour.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: interest without profit and the company-member exception dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the incorporated-company exception and the sub-section (1) purpose limit, narrows being concerned or interested in a contract to 'makes money', and renders misbehaviour as 'bad behaviour'.

original: A product liability action may be brought by a complainant against a product manufacturer or a product service provider or a product seller, as the case may be, for any harm caused to him on account of a defective product.
simplification: If a broken or faulty product hurts you, you can take action against the company that made it, sold it or serviced it.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_b: 'Any harm' is narrowed to a product that 'hurts you', and the three classes of defendant become 'the company'.

original: प्रत्येक लोक अधिकारी का निरंतर यह प्रयास होगा कि वह उपधारा (1) के खंड (ख) की अपेक्षाओं के अनुसार, स्वप्रेरणा से, जनता को नियमित अन्तरालों पर संसूचना के विभिन्न साधनों के माध्यम से, जिनके अन्तर्गत इंटरनेट भी है, इतनी अधिक सूचना उपलब्ध कराने के लिए उपाय करे जिससे कि जनता को सूचना प्राप्त करने के लिए इस अधिनियम का कम से कम अवलंब लेना पड़े।
simplification: सरकारी दफ़्तरों को ख़ुद ही इंटरनेट और दूसरे तरीकों से ज़्यादा जानकारी देनी चाहिए, ताकि लोगों को माँगनी न पड़े।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: regular intervals / clause (kha) dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the regular-intervals requirement and the cross-reference to clause (b) of sub-section (1) that defines what must be published; लोक प्राधिकारी becomes सरकारी दफ़्तर.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, where an order is passed under sub-section (1) of section 72, an appeal shall lie, both on facts and on law from— (a) the order made by the District Commission to the State Commission; (b) the order made by the State Commission to the National Commission; and (c) the order made by the National Commission to the Supreme Court.
simplification: If you disagree with a punishment order from a consumer commission, you can appeal to the next higher one. The highest step is the Supreme Court.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: appeal on facts and law, CrPC override dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the override of the Code of Criminal Procedure, the section 72(1) trigger and the right of appeal on both facts and law.

original: केन्द्रीय सरकार, राजपत्र में किसी अधिसूचना द्वारा, अनुसूची का उस सरकार द्वारा स्थापित किसी अन्य आसूचना या सुरक्षा संगठन को उसमें सम्मिलित करके या उसमें पहले से विनिर्दिष्ट किसी संगठन का उससे लोप करके, संशोधन कर सकेगी और ऐसी अधिसूचना के प्रकाशन पर ऐसे संगठन को अनुसूची में, यथास्थिति, सम्मिलित किया गया या उसका उससे लोप किया गया समझा जाएगा।
simplification: केंद्र सरकार ख़ुफ़िया या सुरक्षा एजेंसियों को खास सूची में जोड़ या हटा सकती है। सूचना छपते ही सूची बदल जाती है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: Gazette notification dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the Gazette notification and the limitation to organisations established by that Government; 'खास सूची' replaces the Schedule.

original: The Central Government may, by notification, make rules to provide for the qualifications, method of recruitment, procedure for appointment, term of office, resignation and removal of the President and members of the District Commission.
simplification: The central government makes the rules about who can lead the District Commission and how they are chosen or removed.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: term and resignation dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the term of office and resignation from the rule-making subjects and the members of the Commission, and states the discretionary power as if the rules are simply made.

original: यदि राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई राज्य सूचना आयुक्त, किसी प्रकार, राज्य सरकार द्वारा या उसकी ओर से की गई किसी संविदा या करार से संबद्ध या उसमें हितबद्ध है या किसी निगमित कंपनी के किसी सदस्य को किसी रूप में से अन्यथा और उसके अन्य सदस्यों के साथ सामान्यतः उसके लाभ में या उससे प्रोद्भूत होने वाले किसी फायदे या परिलब्धियों में हिस्सा लेता है तो वह उपधारा (1) के प्रयोजनों के लिए कदाचार का दोषी समझा जाएगा।
simplification: अगर राज्य सूचना आयुक्त राज्य सरकार के किसी सौदे से फ़ायदा उठाता है, तो इसे बुरा आचरण माना जाएगा।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: interest without profit and company exception dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the incorporated-company exception and the 'for the purposes of sub-section (1)' limit, narrows being concerned or interested in a contract to merely profiting, and renders कदाचार as बुरा आचरण.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973, the District Commission, the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall have the power of a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the trial of offences under sub-section (1), and on conferment of such powers, the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, shall be deemed to be a Judicial Magistrate of first class for the purposes of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973.
simplification: Consumer commissions can act like criminal judges when someone breaks their orders.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: magistrate-of-first-class status and CrPC dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the override of the Code of Criminal Procedure and the deeming of the commissions as Judicial Magistrates of first class for that Code; 'criminal judges' replaces the specific rank.

original: The Central Government shall, by notification, establish with effect from such date as it may specify in that notification, the Central Consumer Protection Council to be known as the Central Council.
simplification: The central government will create a group called the Central Council to look after consumers.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: notification and commencement date dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the notification and the specified commencement date, and adds a purpose ('to look after consumers') that this provision does not state.

original: A person aggrieved by any order passed by the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21 may file an appeal to the National Commission within a period of thirty days from the date of receipt of such order.
simplification: If you don't agree with a decision of the Central Authority, you can complain to the National Commission within 30 days.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: sections 20 and 21 not named; 'complain' for appeal | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the limitation to orders under sections 20 and 21 and the receipt-of-order start date, and calls an appeal a complaint.

original: No act or proceeding of the Central Authority shall be invalid merely by reason of— (a) any vacancy in, or any defect in the constitution of, the Central Authority; or (b) any defect in the appointment of a person acting as the Chief Commissioner or as a Commissioner; or (c) any irregularity in the procedure of the Central Authority not affecting the merits of the case.
simplification: The Central Authority's decisions still count even if a seat is empty or there was a small mistake in how someone was appointed.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: procedural-irregularity limb dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops ground (c), any procedural irregularity not affecting the merits, and the defect-in-constitution limb; 'small mistake' replaces 'any defect'.

original: The Central Government may, by notification in the Official Gazette, amend the Schedule by including therein any other intelligence or security organisation established by that Government or omitting therefrom any organisation already specified therein and on the publication of such notification, such organisation shall be deemed to be included in or, as the case may be, omitted from the Schedule.
simplification: The central government can add spy or security agencies to the special list, or take them off it. Once it announces the change, the list is updated.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: Gazette notification dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the Gazette notification and the limitation to organisations established by that Government; 'the special list' replaces the Schedule.

original: Where a notice is served by the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, under sub-section (1) to a third party in respect of any information or record or part thereof, the third party shall, within ten days from the date of receipt of such notice, be given the opportunity to make representation against the proposed disclosure.
simplification: If the information officer plans to share information about someone else, that person gets 10 days to say why it shouldn't be shared.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the notice served under sub-section (1), so the ten days run from the officer's plan rather than from receipt of the notice.

original: The Central Government shall, by notification, establish with effect from such date as it may specify in that notification, a Central Consumer Protection Authority to be known as the Central Authority to regulate matters relating to violation of rights of consumers, unfair trade practices and false or misleading advertisements which are prejudicial to the interests of public and consumers and to promote, protect and enforce the rights of consumers as a class.
simplification: The central government will create the Central Authority to protect shoppers. It stops unfair business tricks and fake or misleading ads.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: notification and enforcement of class rights dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the notification and commencement date and the mandate to promote, protect and enforce consumer rights as a class; 'consumers' becomes 'shoppers'.

original: The State Chief Information Commissioner and the State Information Commissioners shall be persons of eminence in public life with wide knowledge and experience in law, science and technology, social service, management, journalism, mass media or administration and governance.
simplification: The people who run the State Information Commission must be famous and respected. They should know a lot about things like law, science, journalism or running the government.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: list of fields shortened | llm_claude_opus55_b: Turns the closed list of qualifying fields into an open 'things like' list and drops social service, management, technology and mass media.

original: Where the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be, is satisfied, on the information furnished by the mediator or on the information received from any other person including parties to the complaint and after hearing the mediator, it shall replace such mediator by another mediator.
simplification: If there is a problem with a mediator, the consumer commission will listen to them and then replace them with someone else.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: basis for satisfaction (information from mediator/parties) dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the information sources that trigger replacement (the mediator's own information, or any other person including the parties) and reduces the satisfaction requirement to 'if there is a problem'.

original: Notwithstanding anything contained in section 7, the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall, within forty days after receipt of the request under section 6, if the third party has been given an opportunity to make representation under sub-section (2), make a decision as to whether or not to disclose the information or record or part thereof and give in writing the notice of his decision to the third party.
simplification: When someone else's information is involved, the officer has 40 days to decide whether to share it. The officer then has to tell that person the decision in writing.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: override of s.7 and the condition that the third party was heard are dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the override of section 7, the condition that the third party was given an opportunity under sub-section (2), and the receipt of the section 6 request as the starting point for the forty days.

original: Whoever, fails to comply with any direction of the Central Authority under sections 20 and 21, shall be punished with imprisonment for a term which may extend to six months or with fine which may extend to twenty lakh rupees, or with both.
simplification: If you ignore an order from the Central Authority, you can go to jail or pay a big fine.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: 6 months / 20 lakh limits and 'or both' dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the limitation to directions under sections 20 and 21, the six-month maximum imprisonment and the twenty-lakh-rupee maximum fine.

original: The qualifications and experience required for empanelment as mediator, the procedure for empanelment, the manner of training empanelled mediators, the fee payable to empanelled mediator, the terms and conditions for empanelment, the code of conduct for empanelled mediators, the grounds on which, and the manner in which, empanelled mediators shall be removed or empanelment shall be cancelled and other matters relating thereto, shall be such as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: Special rules decide who can become a mediator, how they are trained and paid, and how they can be removed.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: procedure, terms and code of conduct dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the code of conduct and the terms and conditions of empanelment; 'special rules' replaces regulations.

original: राष्ट्रपति, उस मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या सूचना आयुक्त को, जिसके विरुद्ध उपधारा (1) के अधीन उच्चतम न्यायालय को निर्देश किया गया है, ऐसे निर्देश पर उच्चतम न्यायालय की रिपोर्ट प्राप्त होने पर राष्ट्रपति द्वारा आदेश पारित किए जाने तक पद से निलंबित कर सकेगा और यदि आवश्यक समझे तो, जांच के दौरान कार्यालय में उपस्थित होने से भी प्रतिषिद्ध कर सकेगा।
simplification: जाँच चलने तक राष्ट्रपति सूचना आयुक्त को काम करने से रोक सकते हैं।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: bar from office and reference to SC dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the sub-section (1) reference, and the suspension is said to last while the inquiry runs rather than until the President passes orders on the Supreme Court's report.

original: राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या राज्य सूचना आयुक्त, यथास्थिति, संसद् का सदस्य या किसी राज्य या संघ राज्यक्षेत्र के विधान-मंडल का सदस्य नहीं होगा या कोई अन्य लाभ का पद धारण नहीं करेगा या किसी राजनीतिक दल से संबद्ध नहीं होगा या कोई कारबार नहीं करेगा या कोई वृत्ति नहीं करेगा।
simplification: राज्य सूचना आयुक्त नेता नहीं बन सकते और किसी दल से नहीं जुड़ सकते। वे कोई दूसरी कमाई वाली नौकरी या व्यापार भी नहीं कर सकते।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: profession bar dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the bar on pursuing any profession, and 'cannot become politicians' replaces the specific disqualification from membership of Parliament or a Legislature.

original: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई सूचना आयुक्त, अपना पद ग्रहण करने से पूर्व राष्ट्रपति या उसके द्वारा इस निमित्त प्राधिकृत किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के समक्ष, पहली अनुसूची में इस प्रयोजन के लिए उपवर्णित प्ररूप के अनुसार एक शपथ या प्रतिज्ञान लेगा और उस पर हस्ताक्षर करेगा।
simplification: काम शुरू करने से पहले सूचना आयुक्तों को राष्ट्रपति या उनके चुने व्यक्ति के सामने शपथ लेनी होती है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: form and signature dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the First Schedule form of the oath and the requirement to subscribe (sign) it.

original: Any offence punishable under sections 88 and 89, may, either before or after the institution of the prosecution, be compounded, on payment of such amount as may be prescribed: Provided that no compounding of such offence shall be made without the leave of the court before which a complaint has been filed under section 92: Provided further that such sum shall not, in any case, exceed the maximum amount of the fine, which may be imposed under this Act for the offence so compounded.
simplification: Some offences can be settled by paying money instead of going through a full trial. The court has to agree, and the payment can't be more than the biggest fine allowed.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: sections and timing of compounding dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the identification of the offences under sections 88 and 89 and that compounding is available either before or after prosecution begins.

original: राज्यपाल, उस राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या राज्य सूचना आयुक्त को, जिसके विरुद्ध उपधारा (1) के अधीन उच्चतम न्यायालय को निर्देश किया गया है, ऐसे निर्देश पर उच्चतम न्यायालय की रिपोर्ट की प्राप्ति पर राज्यपाल द्वारा आदेश पारित किए जाने तक, पद से निलंबित कर सकेगा और यदि आवश्यक समझे तो ऐसी जांच के दौरान कार्यालय में उपस्थित होने से प्रतिषिद्ध भी कर सकेगा।
simplification: जब उच्चतम न्यायालय किसी राज्य सूचना आयुक्त की जाँच कर रहा हो, तब राज्यपाल उसे काम करने से रोक सकते हैं।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: bar from office dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the sub-section (1) reference to the Supreme Court and how long the suspension lasts (until the Governor's orders on the report).

original: The Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner shall before he enters upon his office make and subscribe before the President or some other person appointed by him in that behalf, an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the First Schedule.
simplification: Before they start their job, the information commissioners have to make a formal promise in front of the President or someone the President chooses.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: form and signature dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the First Schedule form of the oath and the subscribing (signing) requirement.

original: Every order made by a District Commission, State Commission or the National Commission shall be enforced by it in the same manner as if it were a decree made by a Court in a suit before it and the provisions of Order XXI of the First Schedule to the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 shall, as far as may be, applicable, subject to the modification that every reference therein to the decree shall be construed as reference to the order made under this Act.
simplification: When a consumer commission makes a decision, it must be followed just like a court's decision.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: CPC Order XXI mechanism dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the application of Order XXI of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 and the direction to read references to a decree as references to the order.

original: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई सूचना आयुक्त, यथास्थिति, संसद् का सदस्य या किसी राज्य या संघ राज्यक्षेत्र के विधान-मंडल का सदस्य नहीं होगा या कोई अन्य लाभ का पद धारित नहीं करेगा या किसी राजनैतिक दल से संबद्ध नहीं होगा अथवा कोई कारबार नहीं करेगा या कोई वृत्ति नहीं करेगा।
simplification: सूचना आयुक्त नेता नहीं बन सकते और किसी राजनीतिक दल से नहीं जुड़ सकते। वे कोई दूसरी कमाई वाली नौकरी या व्यापार भी नहीं कर सकते।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: profession bar dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the bar on pursuing any profession, and 'cannot become politicians' replaces the specific disqualification from membership of Parliament or a State or Union territory Legislature.

original: The State Chief Information Commissioner or a State Information Commissioner, shall before he enters upon his office make and subscribe before the Governor or some other person appointed by him in that behalf, an oath or affirmation according to the form set out for the purpose in the First Schedule.
simplification: Before starting their job, state information commissioners must make a formal promise in front of the Governor.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: designee, form and signature dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the alternative person appointed by the Governor, the First Schedule form and the subscribing (signing) of the oath.

original: The Central Authority shall regulate the procedure for transaction of its business and allocation of its business amongst the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners as may be specified by regulations.
simplification: The Central Authority decides how it does its work and who among its leaders does which job.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: 'as specified by regulations' dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the constraint that the procedure and allocation are as specified by regulations, and 'its leaders' replaces the Chief Commissioner and Commissioners.

original: The State Chief Information Commissioner or a State Information Commissioner shall not be a Member of Parliament or Member of the Legislature of any State or Union territory, as the case may be, or hold any other office of profit or connected with any political party or carrying on any business or pursuing any profession.
simplification: State information commissioners can't be politicians or members of a political party. They also can't have another paid job or run a business.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: profession bar dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the bar on pursuing any profession, and 'politicians' replaces the disqualification from membership of Parliament or a State or Union territory Legislature.

original: Where access to the record or a part thereof is required to be provided under this Act and the person to whom access is to be provided is sensorily disabled, the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, shall provide assistance to enable access to the information, including providing such assistance as may be appropriate for the inspection.
simplification: If someone who can't see or hear well asks for records, the information officer has to help them get the information. That includes helping them look at the records.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_b: 'Sensorily disabled' is narrowed to someone who cannot see or hear well.

original: कोई अधिकारी, जिसकी उपधारा (4) के अधीन सहायता चाही गई है, उसकी सहायता चाहने वाले यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी को सभी सहायता प्रदान करेगा और इस अधिनियम के उपबंधों के किसी उल्लंघन के प्रयोजनों के लिए ऐसे अन्य अधिकारी को, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी समझा जाएगा।
simplification: अगर सूचना अधिकारी किसी दूसरे अधिकारी से मदद माँगे, तो उसे मदद करनी होगी। नियम टूटने पर उसे भी ज़िम्मेदार माना जाएगा।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: sub-section (4) and deemed-officer status simplified | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops 'सभी' (all) assistance, and the deeming of the assisting officer as an information officer is softened to being 'treated as responsible'.

original: उपधारा (3) के उपबंधों के अधीन रहते हुए, राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या किसी राज्य सूचना आयुक्त को राज्यपाल के आदेश द्वारा साबित कदाचार या असमर्थता के आधार पर उसके पद से तभी हटाया जाएगा, जब उच्चतम न्यायालय ने, राज्यपाल द्वारा उसे किए गए किसी निर्देश पर जांच के पश्चात् यह रिपोर्ट दी हो कि, यथास्थिति, राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या राज्य सूचना आयुक्त को उस आधार पर हटा दिया जाना चाहिए।
simplification: राज्य सूचना आयुक्त को राज्यपाल तभी हटा सकते हैं जब उसका बुरा व्यवहार या काम न कर पाना साबित हो। इसके लिए पहले उच्चतम न्यायालय को जाँच करके सहमति देनी होती है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: sub-section (3) qualifier dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the 'subject to sub-section (3)' limitation and renders कदाचार as 'बुरा व्यवहार'; the exclusive removal route is otherwise kept.

original: For the purpose of mediation, the National Commission or the State Commission or the District Commission, as the case may be, shall prepare a panel of the mediators to be maintained by the consumer mediation cell attached to it, on the recommendation of a selection committee consisting of the President and a member of that Commission.
simplification: Each consumer commission keeps a list of people who can help both sides agree. A small committee picks these people.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: composition of selection committee dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the composition of the selection committee (the President and a member of that Commission), and the panel is said to be kept by the commission rather than its consumer mediation cell.

original: Subject to the provisions of sub-section (3), the State Chief Information Commissioner or a State Information Commissioner shall be removed from his office only by order of the Governor on the ground of proved misbehaviour or incapacity after the Supreme Court, on a reference made to it by the Governor, has on inquiry, reported that the State Chief Information Commissioner or a State Information Commissioner, as the case may be, ought on such ground be removed.
simplification: A state information commissioner can only be fired by the Governor if they behaved badly or can't do the job. First the Supreme Court has to check and agree.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: sub-section (3) qualifier dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the 'subject to sub-section (3)' limitation and loses 'proved' from proved misbehaviour or incapacity.

original: Subject to the provisions of sub-section (3), the Chief Information Commissioner or any Information Commissioner shall be removed from his office only by order of the President on the ground of proved misbehaviour or incapacity after the Supreme Court, on a reference made to it by the President, has, on inquiry, reported that the Chief Information Commissioner or any Information Commissioner, as the case may be, ought on such ground be removed.
simplification: The President can remove an information commissioner only if they behaved badly or can't do the job, and only after the Supreme Court checks and agrees.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: sub-section (3) qualifier dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the 'subject to sub-section (3)' limitation and weakens 'proved misbehaviour or incapacity' to 'behaved badly or can't do the job'.

original: An information shall ordinarily be provided in the form in which it is sought unless it would disproportionately divert the resources of the public authority or would be detrimental to the safety or preservation of the record in question.
simplification: You should get the information in the form you asked for. But the office can say no if it would take too much work or could damage the records.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: exception allows another form, not a refusal | llm_claude_opus55_b: The exception lets the authority refuse the requested form, not refuse the request outright as 'the office can say no' implies; 'public authority' also becomes 'the office'.

original: The State Commission shall ordinarily function at the State capital and perform its functions at such other places as the State Government may in consultation with the State Commission notify in the Official Gazette: Provided that the State Government may, by notification, establish regional benches of the State Commission, at such places, as it deems fit.
simplification: The State Commission usually works in the state capital, but it can also work in other places the government chooses.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: consultation and regional-bench proviso dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the consultation with the State Commission, the Gazette notification and the proviso allowing regional benches.

original: जहां उपधारा (1) के अधीन, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी द्वारा पर व्यक्ति पर किसी सूचना या अभिलेख या उसके किसी भाग के बारे में किसी सूचना की तामील की जाती है, वहां ऐसे पर व्यक्ति को, ऐसी सूचना की प्राप्ति की तारीख से दस दिन के भीतर, प्रस्तावित प्रकटन के विरुद्ध अभ्यावेदन करने का अवसर दिया जाएगा।
simplification: अगर किसी दूसरे व्यक्ति की जानकारी दी जानी है, तो उसे दस दिन में अपनी आपत्ति बताने का मौका मिलेगा।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: who serves the notice not stated | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the information officer who serves the notice and the fact that the ten days run from receipt of that notice, so the time limit has no starting point.

original: The provisions relating to complaints under sections 35, 36, 37, 38 and 39 shall, with such modifications as may be considered necessary, be applicable to the disposal of complaints by the National Commission.
simplification: The National Commission handles complaints using the same rules as the smaller consumer commissions.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: 'with necessary modifications' dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the identification of sections 35 to 39 and the 'with such modifications as may be considered necessary' qualifier.

original: Every complaint shall be heard by the District Commission on the basis of affidavit and documentary evidence placed on record: Provided that where an application is made for hearing or for examination of parties in person or through video conferencing, the District Commission may, on sufficient cause being shown, and after recording its reasons in writing, allow the same.
simplification: The District Commission mostly decides cases by reading written statements and papers. Sometimes it can let people speak in person or on video.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: conditions for in-person hearing dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: 'Sometimes it can' drops the need for an application and the requirements of sufficient cause and written reasons before an in-person or video hearing is allowed.

original: उपधारा (3) के उपबंधों के अधीन रहते हुए, मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या किसी सूचना आयुक्त को राष्ट्रपति के आदेश द्वारा साबित कदाचार या असमर्थता के आधार पर उसके पद से तभी हटाया जाएगा, जब उच्चतम न्यायालय ने, राष्ट्रपति द्वारा उसे किए गए किसी निर्देश पर जांच के पश्चात् यह रिपोर्ट दी हो कि, यथास्थिति, मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या सूचना आयुक्त को उस आधार पर हटा दिया जाना चाहिए।
simplification: राष्ट्रपति सूचना आयुक्त को तभी हटा सकते हैं जब उसका बुरा व्यवहार या काम न कर पाना साबित हो, और उच्चतम न्यायालय जाँच करके सहमति दे।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: sub-section (3) qualifier dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the 'subject to sub-section (3)' limitation and renders कदाचार as 'बुरा व्यवहार'; the President's exclusive route and the Supreme Court inquiry are kept.

original: राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई राज्य सूचना आयुक्त अपना पद ग्रहण करने से पूर्व राज्यपाल या इस निमित्त उसके द्वारा नियुक्त किए गए किसी अन्य व्यक्ति के समक्ष पहली अनुसूची में इस प्रयोजन के लिए उपवर्णित प्ररूप के अनुसार शपथ या प्रतिज्ञान लेगा और उस पर अपने हस्ताक्षर करेगा।
simplification: काम शुरू करने से पहले राज्य सूचना आयुक्तों को राज्यपाल के सामने शपथ लेनी होती है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: designee, form and signature dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the alternative person appointed by the Governor, the First Schedule form of the oath and the requirement to sign it.

original: धारा 7 में किसी बात के होते हुए भी, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी धारा 6 के अधीन अनुरोध प्राप्त होने के पश्चात् चालीस दिन के भीतर, यदि पर व्यक्ति को उपधारा (2) के अधीन अभ्यावेदन करने का अवसर दे दिया गया है, तो इस बारे में विनिश्चय करेगा कि उक्त सूचना या अभिलेख या उसके भाग का प्रकटन किया जाए या नहीं और अपने विनिश्चय की सूचना लिखित में पर व्यक्ति को देगा।
simplification: किसी दूसरे की जानकारी के मामले में अधिकारी को चालीस दिन में तय करना होता है कि जानकारी दी जाए या नहीं, और उस व्यक्ति को लिखकर बताना होता है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: override of s.7 and the condition that the third party was heard dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the override of section 7, the sub-section (2) opportunity condition and the receipt of the section 6 request as the start of the forty days.

original: Save as otherwise provided, the offences under sub-section (1) shall be tried summarily by the District Commission or the State Commission or the National Commission, as the case may be.
simplification: These offences are handled in a fast, simple trial by the consumer commission.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: saving clause dropped; offences not identified | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the 'save as otherwise provided' saving clause and the identification of the sub-section (1) offences, leaving 'these offences' without an antecedent.

original: जहां, इस अधिनियम के अधीन अभिलेख या उसके किसी भाग तक पहुंच अपेक्षित है और ऐसा व्यक्ति, जिसको पहुंच उपलब्ध कराई जानी है, संवेदनात्मक रूप से नि:शक्त है, वहां यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना तक पहुंच को समर्थ बनाने के लिए सहायता उपलब्ध कराएगा जिसमें निरीक्षण के लिए ऐसी सहायता कराना भी सम्मिलित है, जो समुचित हो।
simplification: अगर जानकारी माँगने वाला व्यक्ति देख या सुन नहीं सकता, तो सूचना अधिकारी को उसकी मदद करनी होगी। इसमें रिकॉर्ड देखने में मदद करना भी शामिल है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_b: 'संवेदनात्मक रूप से नि:शक्त' (sensorily disabled) is narrowed to a person who cannot see or hear.

original: The Chief Information Commissioner or an Information Commissioner shall not be a Member of Parliament or Member of the Legislature of any State or Union territory, as the case may be, or hold any other office of profit or connected with any political party or carrying on any business or pursuing any profession.
simplification: The people who run the Information Commission can't be politicians or join a political party. They also can't have another paid job or run a business.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: profession bar dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the bar on pursuing any profession, and 'politicians' replaces the disqualification from membership of Parliament or a State or Union territory Legislature.

original: Every public authority shall, within one hundred days of the enactment of this Act, designate as many officers as the Central Public Information Officers or State Public Information Officers, as the case may be, in all administrative units or offices under it as may be necessary to provide information to persons requesting for the information under this Act.
simplification: Every government office must choose enough information officers to answer people's requests for information.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: 100-day deadline and all-units requirement dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the hundred-day deadline and the requirement to designate officers in all administrative units or offices; 'government office' replaces public authority.

original: Where the parties agree for settlement by mediation and give their consent in writing, the District Commission shall, within five days of receipt of such consent, refer the matter for mediation, and in such case, the provisions of Chapter V, relating to mediation, shall apply.
simplification: If both sides agree in writing to talk it out, the District Commission sends the case to mediation within 5 days.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: application of Chapter V dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the clause making Chapter V apply, and renders mediation as 'talk it out'.

original: Where the National Commission is satisfied that a substantial question of law is involved in any case, it shall formulate that question and hear the appeal on that question: Provided that nothing in this sub-section shall be deemed to take away or abridge the power of the National Commission to hear, for reasons to be recorded in writing, the appeal on any other substantial question of law, if it is satisfied that the case involves such question of law.
simplification: The National Commission writes down the main legal question in a case and hears the appeal on it. It can also look at other important legal questions if it explains why.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: 'if satisfied the case involves' qualifier dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the condition that the Commission must first be satisfied a substantial question of law is involved, so the duty reads as automatic; 'main legal question' replaces that term.

original: Any officer, whose assistance has been sought under sub-section (4), shall render all assistance to the Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, seeking his or her assistance and for the purposes of any contravention of the provisions of this Act, such other officer shall be treated as a Central Public Information Officer or State Public Information Officer, as the case may be.
simplification: If an information officer asks another officer for help, that officer must help. If rules are broken, that officer can be blamed too.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: deemed-officer status simplified | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops 'all' assistance, and the deeming of the assisting officer as an information officer becomes 'can be blamed too'.

original: राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त और राज्य सूचना आयुक्त विधि, विज्ञान और प्रौद्योगिकी, समाजसेवा, प्रबंध, पत्रकारिता, जनसंपर्क माध्यम या प्रशासन और शासन में व्यापक ज्ञान और अनुभव वाले समाज में प्रख्यात व्यक्ति होंगे।
simplification: राज्य सूचना आयुक्त समाज के जाने-माने लोग होने चाहिए। उन्हें कानून, विज्ञान, पत्रकारिता या सरकार चलाने जैसे कामों की अच्छी समझ होनी चाहिए।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: list of fields shortened | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the State Chief Information Commissioner and several qualifying fields, and turns the closed list of fields into an open 'such as' list.

original: The jurisdiction, powers and authority of the National Commission may be exercised by Benches thereof and a Bench may be constituted by the President with one or more members as he may deem fit: Provided that the senior-most member of the Bench shall preside over the Bench.
simplification: The National Commission can split into smaller groups to hear cases. The most senior member leads each group.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: who constitutes benches and their composition dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the President's power to constitute a Bench and its composition of one or more members as he deems fit.

original: यथास्थिति, संसद् या राज्य विधान-मंडल के किसी अन्य अधिनियम में अंतर्विष्ट किसी असंगत बात के होते हुए भी, यथास्थिति, केन्द्रीय सूचना आयोग या राज्य सूचना आयोग इस अधिनियम के अधीन किसी शिकायत की जांच करने के दौरान, ऐसे किसी अभिलेख की परीक्षा कर सकेगा, जिसे यह अधिनियम लागू होता है और जो लोक प्राधिकारी के नियंत्रण में है और उसके द्वारा ऐसे किसी अभिलेख को किन्हीं भी आधारों पर रोका नहीं जाएगा।
simplification: शिकायत की जाँच करते समय सूचना आयोग कोई भी सरकारी रिकॉर्ड देख सकता है। कोई भी उससे रिकॉर्ड छिपा नहीं सकता।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: override of other Acts dropped; 'any government record' broader than records covered by the Act | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the override of other Acts, and 'any government record' is wider than records to which this Act applies and which are under the public authority's control.

original: The President may suspend from office, and if deem necessary prohibit also from attending the office during inquiry, the Chief Information Commissioner or Information Commissioner in respect of whom a reference has been made to the Supreme Court under sub-section (1) until the President has passed orders on receipt of the report of the Supreme Court on such reference.
simplification: While the Supreme Court is checking a complaint against an information commissioner, the President can stop them from working until a final decision is made.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: power to bar from office during inquiry dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: A Presidential reference to the Supreme Court under sub-section (1) is described as the Court 'checking a complaint', which is a different procedure.

original: राज्य सूचना आयोग का मुख्यालय राज्य में ऐसे स्थान पर होगा, जिसे राज्य सरकार राजपत्र में अधिसूचना द्वारा विनिर्दिष्ट करे और राज्य सूचना आयोग, राज्य सरकार के पूर्व अनुमोदन से, राज्य में अन्य स्थानों पर अपने कार्यालय स्थापित कर सकेगा।
simplification: राज्य सरकार राजपत्र में सूचना देकर तय करेगी कि राज्य सूचना आयोग का मुख्य कार्यालय राज्य में कहाँ हो सकेगा। राज्य सरकार की पहले से अनुमति लेकर आयोग राज्य में दूसरी जगहों पर भी अपने कार्यालय खोल सकता है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: hoga -> ho sakega | llm_claude_opus55_b: 'मुख्यालय ... होगा' becomes 'कहाँ हो सकेगा', a modality shift, though the Gazette notification and the prior-approval condition are kept.

original: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई सूचना आयुक्त, यथास्थिति, संसद् का सदस्य या किसी राज्य या संघ राज्यक्षेत्र के विधान-मंडल का सदस्य नहीं होगा या कोई अन्य लाभ का पद धारित नहीं करेगा या किसी राजनैतिक दल से संबद्ध नहीं होगा अथवा कोई कारबार नहीं करेगा या कोई वृत्ति नहीं करेगा।
simplification: मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या कोई सूचना आयुक्त संसद का या किसी राज्य या संघ राज्यक्षेत्र की विधानसभा का सदस्य होगा। वह कोई दूसरा लाभ का पद नहीं रखेगा, किसी राजनीतिक दल से नहीं जुड़ेगा, और कोई व्यापार या पेशा नहीं करेगा।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: shall not be a member -> shall be a member | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the negation in the first limb, so a disqualification from membership of Parliament or a Legislature reads as a requirement to be a member.

original: धारा 8 के उपबन्धों पर प्रतिकूल प्रभाव डाले बिना, यथास्थिति, कोई केन्द्रीय लोक सूचना अधिकारी या कोई राज्य लोक सूचना अधिकारी सूचना के किसी अनुरोध को वहां अस्वीकार कर सकेगा, जहां पहुंच उपलब्ध कराने के लिए ऐसा अनुरोध राज्य से भिन्न किसी व्यक्ति के अस्तित्वयुक्त प्रतिलिप्यधिकार का उल्लंघन अन्तर्वलित करेगा।
simplification: अगर जानकारी देने से किसी का कॉपीराइट टूटता हो, तो सूचना अधिकारी अनुरोध मना कर सकता है।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: s.8 saving and 'other than the State' dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the 'without prejudice to section 8' clause and the limitation to copyright subsisting in a person other than the State.

original: The State Commission shall ordinarily function at the State capital and perform its functions at such other places as the State Government may in consultation with the State Commission notify in the Official Gazette: Provided that the State Government may, by notification, establish regional benches of the State Commission, at such places, as it deems fit.
simplification: The State Commission will not usually work from the State capital. It can also work at other places that the State Government, after consulting the State Commission, announces in the Official Gazette. The State Government may also set up regional benches of the State Commission at places it thinks suitable.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: shall ordinarily function at capital -> will not usually | llm_claude_opus55_b: Says the State Commission will NOT usually work from the State capital, reversing its ordinary seat and contradicting the rest of the passage.

original: Without prejudice to the provisions of section 8, a Central Public Information Officer or a State Public Information Officer, as the case may be, may reject a request for information where such a request for providing access would involve an infringement of copyright subsisting in a person other than the State.
simplification: An information officer can say no to a request if sharing the information would break someone's copyright.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: s.8 saving and 'other than the State' dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the 'without prejudice to section 8' clause and the limitation to copyright subsisting in a person other than the State.

original: The Governor may suspend from office, and if deem necessary prohibit also from attending the office during inquiry, the State Chief Information Commissioner or a State Information Commissioner in respect of whom a reference has been made to the Supreme Court under sub-section (1) until the Governor has passed orders on receipt of the report of the Supreme Court on such reference.
simplification: While the Supreme Court is checking a complaint against a state information commissioner, the Governor can stop them from working. This lasts until the Governor decides what to do after the court's report.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: bar from office dropped | llm_claude_opus55_b: A Governor's reference to the Supreme Court under sub-section (1) is described as the Court 'checking a complaint', which is a different procedure.

original: राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या राज्य सूचना आयुक्त, यथास्थिति, संसद् का सदस्य या किसी राज्य या संघ राज्यक्षेत्र के विधान-मंडल का सदस्य नहीं होगा या कोई अन्य लाभ का पद धारण नहीं करेगा या किसी राजनीतिक दल से संबद्ध नहीं होगा या कोई कारबार नहीं करेगा या कोई वृत्ति नहीं करेगा।

comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: shall not hold office of profit -> shall hold | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the negation in the office-of-profit limb, so a disqualification from holding another office of profit reads as a requirement to hold one.

original: The Central Government shall, by notification in the Official Gazette, constitute a body to be known as the Central Information Commission to exercise the powers conferred on, and to perform the functions assigned to, it under this Act.
simplification: The Central Government must set up a body called the Central Information Commission by a notice in the Official Gazette. The Commission will not use the powers and carry out the duties given to it under this Act.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: will exercise powers -> will not use the powers | llm_claude_opus55_b: States that the Commission will NOT exercise the powers and functions given to it, reversing the purpose of the provision.

original: राज्यपाल, उस राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या राज्य सूचना आयुक्त को, जिसके विरुद्ध उपधारा (1) के अधीन उच्चतम न्यायालय को निर्देश किया गया है, ऐसे निर्देश पर उच्चतम न्यायालय की रिपोर्ट की प्राप्ति पर राज्यपाल द्वारा आदेश पारित किए जाने तक, पद से निलंबित कर सकेगा और यदि आवश्यक समझे तो ऐसी जांच के दौरान कार्यालय में उपस्थित होने से प्रतिषिद्ध भी कर सकेगा।
simplification: जिस राज्य मुख्य सूचना आयुक्त या राज्य सूचना आयुक्त के ख़िलाफ़ उपधारा (1) के तहत उच्चतम न्यायालय को मामला भेजा गया है, राज्यपाल उसे पद से निलंबित नहीं कर सकते हैं। ज़रूरी लगे तो वे जाँच के दौरान उसे दफ़्तर आने से भी रोक सकते हैं। यह तब तक चलेगा जब तक राज्यपाल उच्चतम न्यायालय की रिपोर्ट मिलने पर आदेश न दे दें।
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: may suspend -> cannot suspend | llm_claude_opus55_b: Says the Governor can NOT suspend the Commissioner, reversing the central power and contradicting the following sentences about its duration.

original: A product manufacturer shall be liable in a product liability action even if he proves that he was not negligent or fraudulent in making the express warranty of a product.
simplification: A product manufacturer is liable in a product liability case even if it proves that it was careless or dishonest when it gave the express warranty for the product.
comments: llm_claude_opus55_a: not negligent or fraudulent -> careless or dishonest | llm_claude_opus55_b: Drops the negation: liability survives proof that the manufacturer was NOT negligent or fraudulent, not proof that it was.
